theme.description: Colours, corners and text as CSS variables, light and dark.

button.description: Six variants and four sizes, on a native button.

field.description: A control with its label, and help or an error under it.

card.description: A panel with a title, description, action, content and footer.

badge.description: A small label: a status, a count, a tag.

alert.description: A message that stays on the page.

table.description: Rows of data under headings, numbers aligned, with an empty state.

alert_dialog.description: Asks before something that cannot be taken back, in the browser's modal dialog.

chart.description: One series as bars, with a readout on hover and focus, and a table view.
